rationale: All deterministic checks pass for persistence, stable alphabetical listing, case-insensitive lookup and removal, explicit overrides, missing-template safety, and banner behavior. The sibling template store is derived consistently from the selected data file and written through a reusable atomic JSON helper. Validation occurs before writes, existing task data remains compatible, and JSON/text conventions plus help are fully integrated. The implementation is well factored across store, name, lookup, and banner helpers; minor duplication between task and template readers and silent temporary-file cleanup keep it just below exceptional code quality. The banner has a strong centered frame, prominent TASKFORGE TEMPLATE SYSTEM title, clear action vocabulary, and balanced whitespace. Tests are focused and the diff contains only relevant source, asset, help, and fixture-test changes.
